title: Quick Chinese Cod Poach
description: A macrobiotic-friendly, quick-fix Chinese cod dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the delicate flavors of cod with the bold taste of ginger and soy sauce.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and 1 cup of water.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger to the sauce and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper.
Add the cod to the saucepan, skin side up (if it has skin), and poach for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the cod from the saucepan and place it on a plate.
Strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a small bowl, discarding the ginger.
Pour the sauce over the cod and garnish with chopped scallions.
Heat the grape seed oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped scallions to the pan and sauté for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
